integrity: The formula follows from explicit five-orbit inclusion-exclusion, exact S^3 two-cap volume, and uniform-Haar integration; separate code checks 2,000,000 independent quotient point pairs and high-precision quadrature.
scientific_limitations: Exact geodesic-distance CDF only on the first overlap window 0 <= r <= arccos(-1/4)/2 for the curvature-one L(5,2); no assertion about the full CDF, other lens spaces, or peer validation. Priority remains subject to older unindexed literature.
title: An exact first-cut-locus distance law for the inhomogeneous spherical lens space \(L(5,2)\)
